text:
lucy: Heads-up — onboarding q3b-int4 multilingual candidate showed regressions on non-English long-doc bench. chrF++ down ~0.06 for ja/ko and we see formatting corruption on multi-paragraph prompts. Uploaded 72 failing prompts to s3://redwood-staging/q3b/multilang/fails/3918200000/list.json. pinging @amir @felix for tokenizer/dedupe + quant triage.

amir: grabbing the list now. Quick skim: many prompts contain mixed directionality, HTML entities, and inline code blocks. I suspect tokenizer normalization variant is the culprit (v3 vs v4). Which ingest version was used?

felix: ran a quick quant-smoke on int4 artifacts. Observed a higher truncation tail and occasional token misalignment when seq>1800 for languages with multi-byte scripts. Snippet: ```
quant-smoke: model=q3b-int4-multilang
longform_fail_rate=0.042
issues: truncation+format-corruption at seq>1800 for CJK
gpu_warns: matmul-fallback on some nodes
```

label-bot: Fail list and short manifest uploaded: s3://redwood-staging/q3b/multilang/fails/3918200000/list.json and s3://redwood-staging/q3b/multilang/manifest_3918200000.csv (fields: prompt_id, md5, tokenhash_v3, lang_tag, embed512_hex). ACL: eng-ml-read.

lucy: ingest used tokenizer v4 (we rolled v4 for multi-script fixes last week). Proposal: assemble a curated regression set "q3b-multilang-regress-3918" target 300 cases (150 CJK-heavy, 100 RTL/multi-dir, 50 code/markup-heavy). Need dedupe against master-multilang-golden using tokenhash_v4 + embed clustering after unicode-normalize NFC and html-unescape. @amir can you run normalization + dedupe with config below?

amir: yep. Dedupe config: 1) unicode-normalize (NFC) -> html-unescape -> remove zero-width control chars; 2) compute tokenhash_v4; 3) exact tokenhash_v4 => drop; 4) embed512 cosine >= 0.90 => cluster; 5) for cross-lang near-duplicates (same meaning different script), flag for manual review. Starting run.

felix: Quant short-term mitigation: route estimated_output_tokens>1700 and lang in (ja,ko,zh,ar,he) to q3b-q4b-compat until runtime kernel patch. I'll add a canary route 8% for 5h. Also logging kernel ticket INF-9001.

label-bot: Dedupe job complete: from 72 fails -> 44 uniques after exact tokenhash_v4 drops (12) and 16 merges. Additionally harvested 260 long-docs stratified by language and source to reach candidate pool = 304. Wrote candidates to s3://redwood-staging/q3b/multilang/golden_candidates_3918200000.csv and /tmp/q3b_multilang_candidates_3918200000.json.

lucy: Nice. Label ops needs: final manifest, a clear multilingual rubric (examples with ja/ko/ar/he), and instructions for code/markup preservation. Who owns the rubric? I can draft base but need native-check examples. @felix can you add language-specific examples?

felix: I'll add 3 examples per script (ja, ko, zh, ar, he) showing hallucination vs acceptable inference, and one example showing acceptable HTML-preservation. Uploading rubric draft to s3://redwood-staging/q3b/multilang/rubric_3918200000.md.

amir: Small note from dedupe: we detected 9 cross-script semantic near-duplicates (e.g., translated variants). I tagged them with cluster_tag=XLAT for manual review; might want to keep both if they surface different model behaviors. Added cluster metadata to the manifest.

label-bot: Candidate manifest includes columns: prompt_id, md5, tokenhash_v4, lang_tag, embed512_hex, cluster_id, cluster_size, cluster_tag. File at s3://redwood-staging/q3b/multilang/golden_candidates_3918200000.csv.

lucy: Label ops estimate: 304 items -> ~48-60h with 3 annotators + 1 QA (we need native speakers for JA/KO/AR/HE; remote contractors ok). I'll coordinate staffing and post schedule. Plan to start after rubric finalization.

infra-bot: Routing rule applied: lang-longform-temp-q3b -> q3b-q4b-compat (8% traffic) until 2026-03-26T12:00:00Z. Ticket INF-9001 created (kernel selection mismatch on older drivers).

felix: For eval-harness: I'll prepare a bilingual devset slice and run after first 60 labels to get per-lang chrF/BLEU deltas. eval-bot, can you schedule a run after label milestone?

eval-bot: Scheduled eval-harness job: q3b-int4-multilang-first60 -> run when /tmp/labels_first60_3918200000.csv appears. Will post results here.

amir: One more technical: during normalization we saw a tokenizer tokenizer-v4 -> tokenhash_v4 mapping difference for sequences containing ZERO WIDTH JOINER and Ligatures; I added a small note in manifest: tokenhash_note=ZWJ_LIG_FIX_APPLIED.

lucy: Good catch. OK team—next steps: 1) felix finalize rubric + native examples by EOD, 2) lucy to post staffing & start date, 3) amir to mark XLAT clusters for manual review and deliver final manifest, 4) infra to monitor canary and pause if per-lang hallucination > baseline + 1 sigma. I'll collect first eval snapshot once eval-bot posts. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
